newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Transaero launches new Siberian route.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Transaero launches new Siberian route.

text.p: Private Russian carrier Transaero said on Tuesday that it had launched thrice-weekly non-stop flights between Moscow and Krasnoyarsk, in Eastern Siberia.

"The airline operates a Boeing 757 passenger jet with two classes of service on Mondays, Thursdays and Fridays on the four and half hour flight from Moscow's Sheremetyevo-1 airport," a spokeswoman said.
The airline flies to 21 destinations in the former Soviet Union and seven other international destinations.
